title: Pop-Up Alice in Wonderland & Disney Holiday Con: Free Springfield, Missouri Event
seo_title: Alice in Wonderland & Disney Holiday Con, Springfield MO
description: This pop-up holiday convention themed around Alice in Wonderland and Disney features free photo ops with Santa Claus and the Grinch, free 9"x12" prints through social media tags or shares, a Saturday ugly Christmas sweater contest, and a Sunday cosplay contest (cosplay is optional). It is for all ages; admission is free, and optional $15 VIP tickets give early entry and are required for VIP perks. It runs Friday, December 11 at 5:00 PM through Sunday, December 13, 2026 at 6:00 PM at the University Plaza Hotel & Convention Center, 333 S John Q Hammons Pkwy in Springfield, MO. Parking at the hotel is $10 per day, free parking is available elsewhere downtown, and photography of the artwork itself is not allowed.
address: 333 S John Q Hammons Pkwy, Springfield, MO 65806-2543, United States, Springfield, MO
